user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a flowering orchid. A flowering moth orchid in a pot: a couple of broad glossy basal leaves, a tall arching flower stem tied to a thin vertical support clip, and a row of blooms with layered petals along the stem. Elegant, delicate. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
